1: Aise huroof ke baare mein guftagu Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hai. Allah qalam ki qasam khata hai aur us ki jo log apne qalamon se likhte hain.
2: Aey Rasool! Aap deewane nahin, us risalat ki wajah se jis se Allah ne aap ko nawaza. Balke aap us deewangi se bari hain jis ka mushrik aap par ilzaam lagate hain.
3: Beshak aap ke liye logon tak paigham pahunchane par ek bada, hamesha rehne wala ajar hai, bagair is ke ke kisi ka aap par koi ehsaan baqi ho.
4: Aur beshak aap us sab se bade akhlaq par hain jo Quran laaya; aap us se poore kamal ke darje tak sanware hue hain.
5: Pas aap jald dekh lenge, aur yeh jhutlane wale bhi dekh lenge,
6: jab haqq zaahir hoga, ke tum mein se waqai kaun deewana tha.
7: Aey Rasool! Beshak aap ka Rubb us shaks ko jaanta hai jo us ke raaste se hat jaata hai, aur woh un ko sab se behtar jaanta hai jo us ki hidayat paate hain. Is liye woh jaanta hai ke wahi hain jo us se bhatak gaye, aur ke aap ko us ki hidayat mili.
8: Pas, aey Rasool, un jhutlane walon ki pairawi na karein us baare mein jo aap laaye hain.
9: Woh chaahte hain ke aap deen ke maamlon mein un ke saath narmi aur samjhauta karein, taake woh badle mein aap ke saath narmi aur meharbani kar sakein.
10: Aur kisi aise shaks ki pairawi na karein jo bohat jhooti qasamein khata hai, aur bad-kirdar hai,
11: jo logon ki bohat gheebat karta hai, aur un ke darmiyan judai daalne ke liye idhar ki baat udhar karta hai,
12: jo bhalai se bohat rokta hai aur logon par un ke maal, un ki izzat aur un ki jaanon mein zulm karta hai; jo aadat se gunahgaar aur nafarman hai,
13: jo hath-dharm aur badtameez hai, apni qaum mein rehta hai bagair un se nasbi taalluq ke.
14: Sirf is liye ke woh maal wala aur bohat se beton wala hai, woh Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman laane se takabbur karta hai.
15: Jab us par Hamari aayaat parhi jaati hain to woh kehta hai: 'Yeh pehle logon ki likhi hui kahaniyan hain.'
16: Hum us ki naak par ek aisi nishani laga denge jo us ke saath rahegi aur use badnuma kar degi.
17: Beshak Hum ne in mushrikon ko qehat aur bhookh se aazmaya, jaise Hum ne baagh walon ko aazmaya jab unhon ne qasam khayi ke woh subah jald us ke phal kaat lenge, taake ghareeb un mein se na kha sakein.
18: Unhon ne aapas mein yeh maamla Allah ki taraf mansoob na kiya, yeh keh kar: 'Agar Allah chahe.'
19: Pas Hum ne us baagh par ek aag bheji jis ne use kha liya jab ke us ke maalik so rahe the, us ka bachaav karne se aajiz.
20: Woh kaala ho gaya, ek andheri raat ki tarah.
21: Subah us ke maalikon ne ek doosre ko pukara,
22: kehte hue: 'Apni kheti ki taraf jald nikal chalo is se pehle ke ghareeb log pahunchein, agar tum waqai apni kheti kaatna chahte ho.'
23: Pas woh apni kheti ki taraf jald chale, aapas mein dheemi awaazon mein baat karte hue.
24: Woh ek doosre se keh rahe the: 'Aaj tumhare paas baagh mein koi ghareeb na aaye.'
25: Woh subah sawere nikle, is irade se ke kisi ko apni kheti tak na pahunchne dein.
26: Phir jab unhon ne apni kheti jali hui dekhi to unhon ne ek doosre se kaha: 'Beshak hum raasta bhool gaye?!'
27: 'Nahin! Hum apni kheti kaatne se mehroom kar diye gaye kyunke hum ne irada kar liya tha ke ghareebon ko us mein se khane se rokein.'
28: Un mein se sab se behtar ne kaha: 'Kya main ne tum se na kaha tha jab tum ne ghareebon ko apni kheti se rokne ka irada kiya: Tum Allah ki tasbeeh aur us ki taraf tauba kyun nahin karte?'
29: Unhon ne kaha: 'Hamare Rubb ki paaki hai; beshak hum ne apne aap par zulm kiya jab hum ne ghareebon ko apne baagh ki kheti se rokne ka faisla kiya.'
30: Pas woh nadamat se ek doosre par ilzaam daalne lage.
31: Unhon ne nadamat se kaha: 'Hum ne kitna nuqsan uthaya! Beshak hum ghareebon ko un ke haqq se mehroom kar ke hadon se aage barh gaye.'
32: 'Hum apne Rubb se umeed rakhte hain ke woh hamein hamare baagh ke badle mein us se behtar de. Beshak hum us ki taraf raaghib hain; hum us se bakshish ki umeed rakhte hain aur us se bhalai chahte hain.'
33: Main un logon ko jo meri nafarmani karte hain waise hi saza deta hoon jaise main ne in logon ko mehroomi ke azaab se saza di. Aur beshak aakhirat ka azaab us se bada hai, agar woh us ki shiddat aur us ke hamesha rehne ko jaante.
34: Beshak jo log Allah se darte hain us ke ahkam baja laa kar aur un cheezon se bach kar jin ki us ne ijazat nahin di, un ke liye un ke Rubb ke paas niyamat ke baagh honge, jahan woh hamesha ki aish mein rahenge.
35: Kya main Moosalmanon ko badle mein kafiron jaisa bana doon, jaisa Makkah ke mushrik daawa karte hain?
36: Aey mushriko! Tumhein kya hua; tum is zaalim aur tedhe nateeje tak kaise pahunchte ho?
37: Kya tumhare paas koi kitab hai jis mein tum parhte ho ke farmanbardar aur nafarman ke darmiyan barabari honi chahiye?
38: Beshak us kitab mein phir tumhare liye woh hota jo tum aakhirat mein chunte.
39: Ya kya tumhare mere saath qasamon se pakke kiye hue ehad hain, ke tumhein woh milega jo tum apne liye tay karo?
40: Aey Rasool! Un se poochhein jo yeh baatein karte hain: 'Is ka un ka zimmedaar kaun hai?'
41: Ya kya un ke Allah ke siwa koi shareek hain jo unhein badle mein mominon ke barabar karte hain? Agar aisa hai to woh apne yeh shareek le aayein agar woh apne is daawe mein sachche hain ke unhon ne unhein badle mein mominon ke barabar kar diya.
42: Qayamat ke din haulnaki waazeh ho jaayegi aur hamara Rubb apni pindli ka ek hissa zaahir karega. Logon ko sajde ki dawat di jaayegi, pas momin sajda karenge, lekin kafir aur munafiq khade reh jaayenge, sajda karne se aajiz.
43: Un ki nazrein jhuki hongi; zillat aur nadamat un par chhayi hogi. Jab ke duniya mein un se Allah ko sajda karne ko kaha jaata tha jab woh us se mehfooz the jis ka woh us din saamna karenge.
44: Aey Rasool! Mujhe us shaks ke saath nipatne dein jo is Quran ko jhutlata hai jo aap par nazil kiya gaya. Main unhein aahista aahista azaab ki taraf le jaoonga, is tarah ke woh na samjhein ke yeh unhein aahista aahista halaakat ki taraf le jaane ka tareeqa hai.
45: Aur main unhein thodi der ki mohlat deta hoon taake woh apne gunah mein hadd se barh jaayein. Beshak kufr aur jhutlane walon ke baare mein meri tadbeer mazboot hai; woh mujh se bach na sakenge aur na mere azaab se mehfooz rahenge.
46: Aey Rasool! Kya aap un se us ka ajar maangte hain jis ki taraf aap unhein bulate hain, jis ki wajah se woh bade bojh mein par gaye aur jo un ke aap se munh pherne ka sabab bana? Haqeeqat is ke ulat hai: aap un se koi ajar nahin maangte; to unhein aap ki pairawi se kya rokta hai?
47: Ya kya un ke paas ghaib ka ilm hai jis se woh woh daleel likh lete hain jo unhein pasand aaye, aur phir use aap ke khilaf bahas mein istemal karte hain?
48: Aey Rasool! Pas apne Rubb ke us faisle ka intezar karein ke unhein mohlat de aur unhein aahista aahista halaakat ki taraf le jaaye. Aur machhli wale jaise na ban jayein, yani Yunus (alaihis salaam) jaise, jo apni qaum se ghussa ho gaye, aur phir apne Rubb ko pukara jab ke woh samandar ke andhere aur machhli ke pet ke andhere mein pareshan the.
49: Agar Allah ki rehmat un tak na pahunchti to machhli unhein ek banjar zameen par phenk deti, malamat kiya hua.
50: Lekin un ke Rubb ne unhein chun liya aur unhein apne nek bandon mein se bana diya.
51: Aur beshak jo log Allah ke saath kufr karte hain aur us ke Rasoolon ko jhutlate hain woh qareeb hain ke aap ko apni nazron se zameen par gira dein, aap ki taraf apni shadeed teez nazron ki wajah se jab woh yeh Quran sunte hain jo aap par nazil kiya gaya. Apni khwahishon ki pairawi karte hue aur haqq se munh pherte hue woh kehte hain: 'Beshak woh Rasool jo use laaye hain deewane hain.'
52: Jab ke yeh Quran jo aap par nazil kiya gaya insaano aur jinnon ke liye ek nasihat aur yaad-dihani ke siwa kuchh nahin.
